about: [O4] The feel measure of the fist fight: press to the step the act starts on (jab, its contact, block, hop, the heavy from its release).

steps.check: [D.jab, D.block, D.hop, D.heavyFromRelease, D.fire, D.crouch, D.reload].filter(Boolean).every((v) => v.mean < 50 && v.n >= 8)
steps.label: every verb acts within 50 ms of its press (mean), on most presses
